allow: PowerShell($ports = 3000,3001,3002; foreach \($p in $ports\) { try { $r = Invoke-WebRequest "http://localhost:$p/" -UseBasicParsing -TimeoutSec 90; Write-Output "PORT $p -> HTTP $\($r.StatusCode\), length $\($r.Content.Length\)"; foreach \($needle in 'SSB Personal Interview','Start interview','Mock session','Preview build'\) { Write-Output \("  contains '{0}': {1}" -f $needle, $r.Content.Contains\($needle\)\) }; break } catch { Write-Output "PORT $p -> $\($_.Exception.Message\)" } })
